a.name: Exp007 native baseline
a.summary: Single Exp007 native z-score checkpoint: continuation epoch 50 / absolute epoch 150.

b.name: Validation-selected category routing
b.summary: Nine distinct checkpoints; each prompt uses the frozen checkpoint assigned to its official category. This is retrospective validation-selected routing, not probability averaging, and its same-validation estimate is optimistic.

c.name: Exp017 iso0.7 best model
c.summary: Single frozen Exp017 continuation epoch 50 / absolute epoch 150 checkpoint, using 0.7 mm fixed-HU preprocessing. Predictions were restored to native CT geometry before postprocessing.

d.name: Top-four equal probability ensemble
d.summary: Ranks 1–4 of frozen j003: Exp007 native, Exp009 baseline, Exp017 iso0.7 and Exp009 S3v2. Float32 sigmoid probabilities are accumulated in rank order; sum >= 2.0. Both anatomy variants derive independently from d1.

e.summary: Original ranks 1–8, equally weighted; paired val200 and test300 caches with unchanged anatomy postprocessors.

fine20.description: Eligible prompt-selected lung side/lobe support, physically dilated 20 mm, applied independently to the raw variant; ineligible or unassigned routes remain unchanged.

raw.description: Thresholded prediction without anatomy postprocessing. For d1 the threshold is applied after the probability average.
raw.name: Raw

semantic_v1.description: d11 = d1 intersected with frozen semantic-v1 support; preserves collaborator parser, whole-lung fallback and absence of our category exclusions.

semantic_v2_strict.description: d12 = d11 followed by the five frozen hard-eligible semantic-v2 signatures. Unselected findings retain d11.
semantic_v2_strict.name: Collaborator semantic-v2 strict

whole_lung20.description: Eligible whole-lung support (labels 10–14), physically dilated 20 mm, applied to the raw variant; ineligible findings remain unchanged.
